IS 16045 : 2013 : Copper Alloy Screw - Down Stop Valves and Stop and Check Valves for Marine ApplicationICS 23.060.20;47.020.30TED 17Reaffirmed 20181. ScopeThis standard specifies requirements for flanged copper alloy screw-down stop valves from 15 to 400 mm nominal sizes of the following types used for water, air, oil or steam upto 120Â°C:a) Globe stop valve known as screw down screw lift valve (SDSL valve);b) Angle stop valve known as screw down screw lift valve (SDSL RA valve);c) Globe stop and check valve known as screw down non-return valve (SDNR valve); andd) Angle stop and check valve known as screw down non-return valve (SDNR RA valve).2. ReferencesThe following standards contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standardsindicated below.210 : 2009 Grey iron castings - Specification (fifth revision)318 : 1981 Specification for leaded tin bronze ingots and castings (second revision)319 : 2007 Free cutting leaded brass bars, rods and section - Specification (fifth revision)320 : 1980 Specification for high tensile brass rods and sections (other than forging stock)1030 : 1998 Carbon steel castings for general engineering purposes (fifth revision)1865 : 1991 Iron castings with spheroidal or nodular graphite (third revision)2062 : 2006 Hot rolled low, medium and high tensile structural steel (sixth revision)3444 : 1999 Corrosion resistant high alloy steel and nickel base castings for general applications - Specification (third revision)4854 (Part 1) : 1969 Glossary of terms for valves and their parts: Part 1 Screw down stop check and gate valve and their parts5414 : 1995 Gaskets and packings - Gland packing jute and hemp - Specification (first revision)6392 : 1971 Steel pipe flanges6603 : 2001 Stainless steel bars and flats - Specification (first revision)7008 (Part 3) : 1988 ISO Metric trapezoidlal screw threads: Part 3 Basic dimensions (first revision)
